_comment: Roland GR-50 SysEx Parameter Map. Derived from Owner's Manual via OCR.
_notes: Handshake: WSD(64), RQD(65), DAT(66), ACK(67), EOD(69), ERR(78), RJC(79).
Max DT1/DAT payload: 256 bytes. Split larger transfers into segments.
OCR-corrected: some ambiguous values marked with '_ocr_note'.

parameter_base_addresses._comment: Table A. Address format: [MSB, MID, LSB] in 7-bit hex.

timbre_temporary._ocr_note: OCR showed 32 twice; second corrected to 48 by stride

rhythm_setup_temporary._comment: ... entries continue at stride 4 through note B7 ...

tone_temporary._ocr_note: OCR '108 03 6' — trailing digit missing, inferred 108 from stride 1:118
OCR '08 13 10' — MSB corrected 4, LSB inferred 28 from stride
OCR '104 18 TE' — 'T' is OCR artifact for '7'

tone_memory._ocr_note: OCR '08 Te 00' twice — 'Te' interpreted as 124 and 126; 64 tones at stride 512 => tone 63 = 8,124,0

patch_memory._comment: ... stride 1:60 (=188 bytes) per patch, 128 patches total ...

timbre_memory_params._note: Half size of timbre temporary; no reserved tail bytes.

tone_params._ocr_note: OCR showed partial offsets as 14/72/258/316; in 7-bit space these are single-byte offsets within a block — using as-is; verify on device.

partial._note: Same layout for partials 1-4; add partial_N_offset to base.

params.name: tvf_key_follow
params._ocr_note: OCR 'o-uci-' — inferred 0-14 by analogy with panpot

display_params._note: Write-only. LCD is 2 rows x 16 chars. No RQ1/RQD read supported.

write_request_params._note: Simulates the front-panel Write key. Write Result is returned at address [64,16,0].

internal._note: 6 strings, each 20 bytes. Within each string: mode_group at +0, 1st_tone at +2, 2nd_tone at +11.

tone_group._note: Same layout for 1st and 2nd tone groups.

external._note: 2 branches (A, B), each 24 bytes. Within each: general_group at +0, individual_group at +6.

patch_chain_params._note: 25 steps x 2 bytes. First byte of step 1 is always 0 (fixed). End mark=1 terminates chain.
